"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to their base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title)
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")
EOF
cat > textutil/truncate.py <<'EOF'
"""Text truncation for previews."""

ELLIPSIS = "..."


def truncate(text, limit):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, cutting at a word boundary and adding "..."."""
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    budget = limit - len(ELLIPSIS)
    if budget <= 0:
        return ELLIPSIS[:limit]
    head = text[:budget]
    # If the cut falls exactly between words, the head is already whole words.
    if text[budget].isspace():
        return head.rstrip() + ELLIPSIS
    # Otherwise drop the partial word at the end.
    idx = max(head.rfind(" "), head.rfind("\t"), head.rfind("\n"))
    if idx == -1:
        return ELLIPSIS
    return head[:idx].rstrip() + ELLIPSIS
EOF
